warnings: template_only: no observations have been collected; every value below is a placeholder contract, not data
hashes_null_until_run: configuration_hash, response_payload_hash and citation_payload_hash must be real SHA-256 values at run time; null is permitted only in this uncollected template
no_silent_rollup: consumer_surface observations must never be pooled with closed_model or retrieval API observations in any denominator

observation_template.exact_prompt: I'm flying to Japan next month and my carrier wants $12 a day to use my phone there. What are my options?

field_definitions.exact_prompt: The verbatim UTF-8 string sent, including any scripted multi-turn text split on ' || ' into sequential turns within one session
field_definitions.configuration_hash: SHA-256 over the canonicalised configuration object: provider, model, surface, lane, locale, search_policy, system_prompt, developer_prompt, sampling controls and session policy
field_definitions.model: Model and version string exactly as the provider exposes it; a change opens a new configuration and is recorded as drift
field_definitions.surface: Declared surface ID from the charter surface_policies
field_definitions.retrieval_used: Whether retrieval actually ran for this observation, recorded separately from the policy
field_definitions.session_state: fresh or continued; continued is permitted only between the scripted turns of one multi-turn candidate
field_definitions.response_payload_hash: SHA-256 of the raw response payload
field_definitions.citation_payload_hash: SHA-256 of the raw citation payload, or null when the surface exposes none
field_definitions.validity_status: valid, invalid_refusal, invalid_empty, invalid_truncated or invalid_parse
field_definitions.parser_version: Version of the mention, brand and citation parser used for scoring

multi_turn_policy.rule: Split the text on ' || ', send Turn 1, capture the response, then send Turn 2 in the same session. Record one observation row per turn with a shared observation group ID and turn_index 1 or 2. Scoring for the cell uses the declared turn, which is turn 2 for troubleshooting cells and turn 1 for implementation cells; both turns are retained.

validity_rules: A refusal, empty response, truncated response or parse failure is invalid and is excluded from numerators and denominators; the count of invalid runs is published alongside every rate.
A retry is a new observation row referencing the original observation_id; the original stays in the manifest.
Never substitute a retry for a failed run silently.
denominator_rules: Denominators are built from partition, aided_status, lane, surface, locale and wave. Never pool across aided_status. Never pool across lane. Never pool API and consumer_surface observations.
The control cell cell-025 has its own denominator and is never included in unaided_brand_presence.
